title: French articles and negation fluency
summary: Expanded the French opinions lesson to explicitly teach the definite article and le/la/l’/les, explain and practise ne…pas, add pronunciation controls beside new French examples, make prior vocabulary meanings reveal on demand, and extend the language into Sai-relevant activities.

areas.title: Definite articles
areas.summary: Explained that les means the, defined definite article and introduced le la l’ and les

areas.title: Negation
areas.summary: Explained ne…pas and n’aime pas with additional practice

areas.title: Pronunciation
areas.summary: Added hear controls beside new French sentences and grammar examples

areas.title: Retrieval
areas.summary: Made old vocabulary English meanings reveal on touch so recall is attempted first

areas.title: Personalisation
areas.summary: Added sailing hockey netball orchestra and swimming French examples

areas.title: Source fidelity
areas.summary: Kept beaucoup as an optional intensifier from the school reference sheet rather than part of the core phrase

data.notes: Current app data is local-only. Firebase architecture is documented but not connected. Historical snapshots do not imply historical learner data.
